compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = \"SF2\": sf2,\n        \"SF1_times_SF2\": sf1 * sf2,\n        \"blinded_region_gev\": [lo, hi],\n        \"blinding_note\": \"Observed TI data in the 125+/-2 GeV window is never inspected, counted, compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = \"SF2\": sf2,\n        \"SF1_times_SF2\": sf1 * sf2,\n        \"blinded_region_gev\": [lo, hi],\n        \"blinding_note\": \"Observed TI data in the 125+/-2 GeV window is never inspected, counted, compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = plotted. compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = \"SF2\": sf2,\n        \"SF1_times_SF2\": sf1 * sf2,\n        \"blinded_region_gev\": [lo, hi],\n        \"blinding_note\": \"Observed TI data in the 125+/-2 GeV window is never inspected, counted, compute_sideband_scale_factors(had_df, cfg):\n    lo, hi = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"signal_window_gev\"]\n    (sb1_lo, sb1_hi) = cfg[\"mass_windows\"][\"sideband_low_gev\"]\n    (sb2_lo, sb2_hi) = \"SF2\": sf2,\n        \"SF1_times_SF2\": sf1 * sf2,\n        \"blinded_region_gev\": [lo, hi],\n        \"blinding_note\": \"Observed TI data in the 125+/-2 GeV window is never inspected, counted, \"SF2\": sf2,\n        \"SF1_times_SF2\": sf1 * sf2,\n        \"blinded_region_gev\": [lo, hi],\n        \"blinding_note\": \"Observed TI data in the 125+/-2 GeV window is never inspected, counted,
